project_type: Python FastAPI backend (Syrabit educational AI app)
build_system: pip with requirements.txt (compiled from requirements.in via pip-compile)
test_framework: pytest with anyio async support, httpx AsyncClient for API tests, unittest.mock for mocking
verification_instructions: Run pytest tests/ from the backend directory. All existing tests must pass. Specifically test_auth.py must pass including the refresh and protected endpoint tests.
setup_instructions: pip install -r apps/backend/requirements.txt && pip install -r apps/backend/requirements-dev.in (or pytest httpx)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.11 available via pyenv. No Docker daemon needed for this task.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns.
key_patterns: Auth dependency is in app/api/v1/auth.py. get_current_user is a FastAPI Depends() used by all protected endpoints. JWT tokens use PyJWT (pyjwt). Exception handling pattern: catch HTTPException first and re-raise, then catch specific JWT errors, then catch-all. Tests use conftest.py fixtures with mocked rate limiting and mocked User model.
directory_structure: apps/backend/ is the Python backend. app/ has api/v1/ (route modules), core/ (security, logging), db/ (mongo, redis), models/, services/, config.py, main.py. tests/ has pytest test files and conftest.py.
